summary: The Real Brokerage Inc. filed Form 6-K disclosing its pending acquisition of RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. via an Arrangement Agreement dated April 26, 2026. Real formed a new holding company, Rome Wildlife, Inc. (to be renamed Real REMAX Group Inc.), which will trade on Nasdaq under symbol REAX after closing. The transaction requires approval from both companies' shareholders, with special meetings scheduled for August 14, 2026. The S-4 registration statement was declared effective July 9, 2026. Closing is expected in H2 2026. No deal terms (price, premium) are specified in this excerpt. Watch for shareholder vote outcomes and regulatory clearances.
